provenance: Original source written for this library; no third-party character, frames or assets. The actor identity is the repository's own synthetic fixture stage2d/fixtures/original-actor.json.
describes: Six-second nonverbal beat: the character looks up (anticipation), catches a falling pear (action), and responds after the catch lands, holding the pose (reaction).
main_event_without_text: A pear falls into the character's mitt and the character visibly reacts to having caught it.
score_links: Beat times come from the existing score: `event: ev-pear-drop` is resolved through eventBindings. This file adds no second timeline.
invariants: the reaction starts after the catch result
pear stays attached to the hand once caught
boil is line-only; no text or whole-frame wobble
limitations: no rigging beyond Rasan2D's five views
unvalidated: pear fall path and hand coordinates need a frame check once testing is approved

beats.serves: the pear falling is the cause; the response follows its landing
